objective: A scan that covered materially less than the one before it is flagged as not comparable
input: A scan executing one of five checks, then the trend
expected: That point reports comparableToPrevious false with the reason. A drop in findings after a narrowed scan is not an improvement, and a trend line that slopes down anyway is the most dangerous chart a security tool can produce
detail: This scan executed 1 check(s) against the previous scan's 5. A drop in findings cannot be read as an improvement.
